authorization.basis: The user explicitly approved Phase C after the Phase-B technical pass on 2026-09-01.

purpose: Run exactly eight balanced development mocks with a finer nonlinear PMWD truth, four HMC chains per mock, heldout prediction, posterior predictive diagnostics, nuisance-identifiability diagnostics, and global/frozen-ROI truth calibration. This is a development pilot, not validation, actual-data inference, or a resolution/frontier claim.

Phase_A_datum.read_contract: read raw_selection_exposure only; counts_all, counts_train, and counts_holdout are forbidden

CF4_catalog.read_contract: read the catalog to construct fixed geometry, uncertainty, BGc design, and holdout mask; discard the constructed observed vobs before inference and generate a mock velocity datum

external_population_prior.source: Lavaux and Jasche 2016, MNRAS 455, 3169, Table 1 in arXiv:1509.05040

truth_model.initial_field: N64 orthonormal white field with every N32 non-Nyquist signed Fourier mode inherited exactly from numpy PCG64 standard_normal(seed); independent high modes use SeedSequence([seed,high_k_white_tag])
truth_model.dynamics: PMWD second-order LPT plus particle-mesh evolution to a=1 in the frozen LCDM cosmology
truth_model.six_population_mean: published external mean density rescaled by volume and imposed on the generator expectation, never normalized to a realized or observed count total
truth_model.coarse_truth: conservative block sum of N64 mass and momentum to N32

stress.A: PMWD nonlinear density with positive six-population Poisson log intensity in real space
stress.B: A plus observer-centred coherent spherical RSD
stress.C: B plus population-dependent FoG and redshift-error broadening
stress.D: C plus gamma-Poisson overdispersion, order-4/perturbed selection, and a smooth log-intensity discrepancy
stress.technical_stress_semantics: The fixed values span implementation stress; they are not claimed as final externally calibrated nuisance distributions.

inference_model.latent: N32 whitened LCDM linear z=0 density/velocity prior
inference_model.RSD: observer-centred coherent spherical velocity displacement plus a two-node symmetric population-FoG quadrature and conservative TSC
inference_model.selection_basis: two standardized fixed radial/dipolar angular log-response templates
inference_model.count_likelihood: conditional Poisson in all arms so arm D tests deliberate overdispersion misspecification
inference_model.velocity_likelihood: fixed-geometry CF4 BGc Gaussian mean-radial-velocity/sigma factor with four standardized nuisance parameters

heldout.mock_rule: independent Poisson thinning conditional on intensity; in arm D both thinnings share the same gamma intensity multiplier
heldout.selection_only_baseline: six population rates estimated from training totals with fixed Gamma(0.5,0.5) regularization and raw order-6 exposure
heldout.Phase_C_delta_LPD_semantics: diagnostic point estimate only; the block bootstrap and positive-lower-bound decision rule must be frozen before Phase D

sampler.algorithm: BlackJAX Euclidean HMC with diagonal window adaptation
sampler.MAP_optimizer: SciPy L-BFGS-B with exact JAX gradient

pilot_flags.semantics: sampler-usability flags only; failure is recorded per arm and cannot tune or promote Phase D after outcomes are seen

diagnostics.ROI_contract: the already frozen Local Group, Virgo, Coma, Local Void, Bootes Void, and observer-environment raised-cosine windows; N32 partial-volume quadrature is reported as underresolved
diagnostics.posterior_predictive_spectrum: population-separated Pearson-residual P0, fixed-z-axis P2, and isotropic 2PCF; the fixed-z P2 is a diagnostic only and is not substituted for the spherical-LOS likelihood
required_reports: rank-normalized split Rhat, bulk/tail ESS, divergence fraction, energy
nuisance posterior covariance rank and correlations
heldout count LPD against the six-rate selection-only baseline and velocity heldout LPD
count histogram, zero fraction, radial counts, angular-template residuals, P0, P2, and 2PCF by population
density and velocity truth response, cross-correlation, residual power, posterior variance reduction, and 68/95 coverage globally and by frozen ROI
unpooled two-member summaries for every stress arm
